# Strava Community Hub

> > Official community platform for Strava athletes, developers, and club organizers featuring forums, product updates, and the invitation-only Superuser Program.

The Strava Community Hub serves as the central gathering place for the Strava athlete community, powered by Gainsight. It provides spaces for general discussion, technical support, API development collaboration, club management resources, and exclusive recognition programs for active community members.

## Key Topics

- Strava API
- Superuser Program
- Community Forums
- Athlete Community
- Developer Community
- Club Management
- Device Connections
- Product Updates
- Community Engagement
- Recognition & Rewards
- Technical Support
- Insider Journal
- API Discussion
- Feature Troubleshooting

## Community Programs

- [Superuser Program](https://communityhub.strava.com/p/superuser-program): Invitation-only Superuser Program for recognition and community support

## Community Forums

- [General Chat [former Campfire Chat]](https://communityhub.strava.com/general-chat-2): General community forum for athlete discussions (formerly Campfire Chat)
- [Strava Features Chat](https://communityhub.strava.com/strava-features-chat-5): Community forum for troubleshooting and questions about Strava features
- [The Club Hub](https://communityhub.strava.com/the-club-hub-3): Club organizers hub for engagement tips and Clubs feature updates
- [Devices and Connections](https://communityhub.strava.com/devices-and-connections-6): Technical support forum for device tracking and connection troubleshooting

## Developers & API

- [Developers & API Forum](https://communityhub.strava.com/developers-api-7): Developer community forum for Strava API discussion and collaboration

## News & Updates

- [Insider Journal](https://communityhub.strava.com/insider-journal-9): Insider Journal with product tips, how-tos, and news from Strava experts
- [What's New](https://communityhub.strava.com/what-s-new-10): Product updates and integration announcements for Strava community
